title: Fatigue test log
line: Fit S-N curves to a table of fatigue test results.
description: An app that holds constant-amplitude fatigue results for three alloys in a table and plots them as S-N data. A pop-up menu picks an alloy, and the Basquin fit and the stress amplitude at 10^7 cycles appear as TeX labels.
thumbnailAlt: An app window with a table of fatigue specimens beside S-N data for three alloys and a Basquin fit line, rendered by RunMat
